purpose: Convert failed admission, blocked routing, contradictory proof, or weak-agent misuse into a precise continuation artifact without inventing an environment blocker.

steps.action: classify the terminal state as not-attempted, admission-failed, no-eligible-agent, capability-blocked, authority-blocked, deterministic-failure, stale-evidence, or runtime-failure
preserve the strongest actually observed proof level and explicitly reject any higher unsupported claim
record the exact failed or unattempted operation, last child command when applicable, exit identity, artifact paths, and correlation or run binding
name whether repair belongs to harness, product, environment, provider, or operator authority; do not convert not-attempted into environment-blocked
emit one exact dependency-aware next workflow or command and the artifact it must produce
write agent-admission-final-handoff.json and an English operator summary outside the repository; receiver must re-inspect current state

proofCeiling: Failure identity and continuation evidence only; a handoff never converts blocked or unattempted work into successful runtime proof.
